phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: From never having coded to writing small programs that read input, make decisions, repeat work, and organise data in lists, dictionaries and files.

phases.title: Thinking like a programmer
phases.summary: Problem-solving method, recursion, algorithm analysis, searching and sorting, and the everyday tools of a working programmer: modules, the shell, Git, tests.

phases.title: Objects and design
phases.summary: Object-oriented programming from first principles to Python's data model, type hints, design principles and patterns.

phases.title: Data structures and algorithms
phases.summary: Build every core data structure yourself, master the algorithm families, and solve interview problems under time pressure.

phases.title: Advanced Python
phases.summary: How Python really works: iterators, decorators, the memory model, descriptors, metaclasses, CPython internals, performance and concurrency.

phases.title: Professional engineering
phases.summary: Testing, packaging, collaboration, databases, the web, security, system design, and Python for data and machine learning.

phases.title: Mastery
phases.summary: A six-week capstone, real open-source contributions (including to CPython), interview mastery, and a final exam and portfolio.
